verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a statistics engine behind experiments: results report metric lifts with confidence intervals and statistical significance, power analysis sets duration, and CUPED and stratified sampling are offered as variance-reduction tools. A practitioner credits the product with balancing velocity and statistical rigor. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming the methodology (frequentist vs. Bayesian) and its test details, evidence that CUPED is available outside the Warehouse Native context, and in-depth statistical methodology docs.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can trust a documented statistics engine (Bayesian or frequentist, with variance-reduction options) behind experiment results
